title: AgentGuard: Securing an LLM Agent from the Inside
caption: The ShopGuard demo after a request to read /etc/passwd: injection flagged, tool call blocked, session marked BLOCKED.
description: Security built into a LangGraph agent as graph nodes: YAML access control, PII redaction before the model sees tool results, encoding-aware injection checks, session correlation and an ML risk score. 54 red-team attacks, one gap found and fixed.
